mapper.select: select l.RULE_LN_ID, l.RULE_ID, l.USER_ID, (select u.DESCRIPTION from SYS_USER u where u.USER_ID = l.USER_ID) as USER_ID_N, (select u.EMAIL from SYS_USER u where u.USER_ID = l.USER_ID) as EMAIL, l.TYPE, (select v.MEANING from SYS_CODE_VALUE_B_V v where v.CODE = 'SYS.MAIL_RECEIVER_TYPE' and v.CODE_VALUE = l.TYPE) as TYPE_N from SYS_MESSAGE_EMAIL_RULE_LN l where l.RULE_ID = #{ruleId} order by l.RULE_LN_ID asc
select l.RULE_LN_ID, l.RULE_ID, l.USER_ID, (select u.EMAIL from SYS_USER u where u.USER_ID = l.USER_ID) as EMAIL, l.TYPE from SYS_MESSAGE_EMAIL_RULE_LN l where l.RULE_ID = #{ruleId}
